body.p:
To prepare the project for translation, generate an XLIFF file for each target language as follows:
Open the main DITA map in the DITA Maps Manager.
Right-click the map and select Translate (Fluenta) Generate XLIFF .This action is visible only if there is a Fluenta project associated with the current DITA map and the XLIFF files will be generated for this project.
In the resulting dialog box, select the Output folder for the XLIFF file(s) and the Target language(s) for translation.
Configure the other XLIFF generation options as desired:
DITAVAL file - Allows users to include a DITAVAL file. This file controls content conditionality, enabling exclusion of specific sections in the generated XLIFF files for translation. This option is useful in some use cases, such as when you do not want certain content translated into specific languages to reduce translation costs.
XLIFF version - Choose the appropriate XLIFF version from this drop-down menu to ensure compatibility with your translation systems.
Reuse ICE matches - Compares the current content with the content available the last time an XLIFF file was generated and reuses all existing translations.
Use translation memory - Uses the translation memory associated with the project to recover translations for the segments not yet translated.
Ignore translatable SVG files - Excludes the SVG files that contain translatable text from the generated XLIFF file.
Segment by paragraphs - Enables paragraph segmentation instead of the default sentence segmentation for more accurate and contextually appropriate segmentation.
Click Generate when finished.
Result: An XLIFF file will be generated in the output folder for each selected language.
